zh.title: 阿聯酋航空將在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募活動
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空將於10月28日至29日在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募活動。
body: 阿聯酋航空將於2026年10月28日及29日在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募巡迴說明會。公司於10月8日宣佈這項安排，並將與當地招募機構 Industrial Personnel and Management Services Inc.（IPAMS）合作。第一天的場次安排在當地時間10時及13時，第二天則於當地時間10時舉行。
招募對象包括有經驗的商用飛行員，職位涵蓋副機長及直聘機長，也包括透過 Accelerated Command Program 招募。說明會也將介紹一項面向資深窄體客機機長的招募計畫，對象是希望直接擔任阿聯酋航空全寬體機隊機長的人員。

en.title: Emirates to hold first pilot recruitment roadshow in the Philippines
en.summary: Emirates will hold its first Philippines pilot recruitment roadshow in Manila on October 28 and 29.
body: Emirates will hold its first pilot recruitment roadshow in the Philippines on October 28 and 29, 2026. The airline announced the event on October 8 and is partnering with local recruitment agency Industrial Personnel and Management Services Inc. (IPAMS). Sessions are scheduled for 10:00 and 13:00 local time on October 28, and 10:00 local time on October 29.

The airline is seeking experienced commercial pilots for first officer and direct-entry captain positions, as well as through its Accelerated Command Program. The sessions will also cover a campaign for experienced narrowbody captains seeking to move directly into command on Emirates’ all-widebody fleet.

zh.title: 威斯康辛州Piper JetProp墜毀造成六人死亡 飛行員曾通報結冰
zh.summary: Piper JetProp在威斯康辛州墜毀，六人死亡；飛行員曾通報結冰。
body: 一架Piper JetProp DLX於2026年10月13日在美國威斯康辛州墜毀，機上五名成人及一名兒童死亡。飛機墜落在威斯康辛州Dellona鎮、Wisconsin Dells附近的林地。
美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）於10月14日表示，飛行員曾通報在24,000英尺高度遇到結冰，並請求下降高度；航空管制批准下降後，飛機進入下降中的右轉，轉彎速率持續增加，隨後通訊與追蹤資料中斷。飛機當時由Kenosha飛往Menomonie。

en.title: Piper JetProp crash in Wisconsin kills six; pilot reported icing
en.summary: A Piper JetProp crashed in Wisconsin, killing six; the pilot reported icing.
body: A Piper JetProp DLX crashed in Wisconsin on October 13, 2026, killing five adults and a child. The aircraft went down in a wooded area in the Town of Dellona, near Wisconsin Dells.

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) said on October 14 that the pilot reported encountering icing at 24,000 feet and requested a descent. Air traffic control approved the descent. The aircraft then entered a descending right turn that increased in rate, after which communications and tracking data were lost. The aircraft was flying from Kenosha to Menomonie.

zh.title: Starfighters Space預計12月以F-104搭載STARLAUNCH 1進行繫留飛行
zh.summary: Starfighters Space預計12月以F-104進行STARLAUNCH 1繫留飛行
body: Starfighters Space預計於12月使用Lockheed F-104 Starfighter，將首個STARLAUNCH 1飛行載具掛在機翼下方，執行繫留飛行。報導指出，首趟飛行將從Kennedy Space Center前往獲FAA許可的Cecil Spaceport，位於Jacksonville, Florida；火箭在任務全程會保持連接於飛機。
這次飛行是多次飛行測試計畫的第一步，並非釋放或點燃火箭。Starfighters Space規劃後續在大西洋上空進行投放測試，再展示整合推進系統。

en.title: Starfighters Space Plans December F-104 Captive-Carry Test of STARLAUNCH 1
en.summary: Starfighters Space expects an F-104 to carry STARLAUNCH 1 on a December captive-carry flight.
body: Starfighters Space expects a Lockheed F-104 Starfighter to carry the first STARLAUNCH 1 flight vehicle beneath its wing in December. The first flight is planned from Kennedy Space Center to the FAA-licensed Cecil Spaceport in Jacksonville, Florida. The rocket will remain attached to the aircraft throughout the captive-carry mission.

The December sortie is expected to be the first step in a multi-flight campaign, rather than an attempt to release or ignite the rocket. Starfighters plans to follow it with a drop test over the Atlantic Ocean and subsequently a demonstration of the integrated propulsion system.
